criteria.check: Evaluate the efficiency and logic of the agent's workflow in combining the three skills.

levels.1.0: The agent read the station list, downloaded NWS thresholds with the truncation fix, fetched USGS instantaneous data (00065), aggregated to daily max, and saved the filtered results.
